standard.coverage: Private employers. Retail and service businesses with less than $500,000 in annual gross income are exempt from the state rate (Mo. Rev. Stat. 290.500(3)(c)); public employers are excluded from the Proposition A increases.
standard.note: Proposition A (2024). Its CPI escalator, which would have started in 2027, was REPEALED by HB 567 in 2025 -- Missouri is now flat at $15.00 until the legislature or the voters act again.

tipped.note: Missouri caps the tip credit at 50% of the minimum wage.

indexation.note: Proposition A's annual CPI adjustment was struck by HB 567 (2025) before it ever took effect.
